item.title: Ubisoft Wants Rayman To Become A Huge, Transmedia Star

description.p: Legends Retold is just the beginning.Ubisoft is gearing up to launch Rayman Legends Retold, a reimagined remake of the 2013 original. While many have questioned the decision to remake a game that arguably still looks and plays great to this day, the developers have been clear in their intention to use Retold as a launchpad for the future of the franchise.Now, in a new interview with The Game Business, brand producer Loïc Gounon has expressed much broader ambitions for the character, perhaps bringing Rayman more in line with something like Sonic in terms of visibility.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Review: Gamesir Nova Vision Controller For Switch 1 & 2 - Unique Features Elevate This Mid-Range Pad

description.p: What a vision.Accessory developer Gamesir doesn’t often make controllers with the Switch 1 and 2 in mind, instead focusing primarily on Xbox and PC. So when it announced the new Nova Vision, my Spider-Sense tingled.The latest entry in the mid-range Nova line, the Vision adds two unique features: a colour LCD screen for quick and easy customisation, and Hall Effect analogue sticks with adjustable tension without the need for extra tools. At $54.99, this is a compelling controller as it is, but Gamesir has also included a charging stand to ensure you’re always good to go.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Talking Point: Ocarina Of Time Revolutionised The 3D Swordfight, But How Does The Remake Hold Up In A Vintage Year For Clashing Blades?

description.p: Finding the cutting edge of sword combat.Forget the hubbub around Grand Theft Auto. Big Walk? Big deal. It’s all noise designed to distract us from 2026’s real legacy: that it’s been one of the best years on record for video game swordfighting.Onimusha: Way of the Sword broke free of parryslop with exciting, flexible and immensely satisfying katana combat. Blood of Dawnwalker’s directional combat recreated a scintillating sense of strike-and-counterstrike rhythm rather than asking players to hide behind defensive blocks. Then Phantom Blade Zero swans in with cinematic style and a dazzling flurry of wuxia sword strikes and somersaults.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: "Here We Go Again" - After Delaying For Silksong, Indie Dev Braces For A Sea Of Sorrow Clash

description.p: "Does the universe have it in for us?".There were a good few indies set for launch in September last year that ended up being delayed to escape the blast radius of Hollow Knight: Silksong. Aeternum Game Studios' metroidvania, Aeterna Lucis, was one such title, pushing its release date to 3rd December 2026 to ensure it was way out of the way of whatever Team Cherry was cooking up. Heh, well...Yesterday, the Silksong dev announced an upcoming 'Cherry Time' special presentation, promising news and announcements from the studio, and an update on the hotly-anticipated Sea of Sorrow DLC. The showcase is tomorrow (27th November), so there's every chance that, in dodging the initial launch, Aeterna Lucis has wound up right in the way of the DLC (thanks, Steam Hype).Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: EA Sports FC 27 Is Using AI To Add The Voice Of Late Commentator John Motson

description.p: Motson's widow and son gave permission.EA Sports FC 27 will today add the voice of the iconic commentator John Motson, who sadly passed away in 2023.This marks the first instance a dead commentator will be added to the game, and EA has used a combination of old recordings and AI to make it happen. In fact, senior game design director Mat Prior states that this is "the only way" that Motson could be added, since there are no recordings of him talking about modern players like Chloe Kelly and Bradley Barcola.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
